description: This file defines API routes for log analysis, including uploading logs, running analysis, and retrieving results, within a FastAPI app. It includes route handlers, data models, and integrates with database models and analysis services.

classes.name: AnalyzeRequest
classes.description: Data model for analyze request parameters, including incident name, source system, environment, metadata, and parser name.

methods.name: UploadResponse upload_log( source_system: str | None = None, environment: str | None = None, file: UploadFile = File(..., description="Log file to upload."), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Endpoint to upload a log file; saves the upload info to the database.

methods.name: RunCreateResponse analyze_upload( upload_id: uuid.UUID, request: AnalyzeRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Endpoint to trigger analysis on an uploaded log, performs parsing, analysis, and saves results.

methods.name: RunStatusResponse get_run_status(run_id: uuid.UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve the status and summary of a specific analysis run.

methods.name: StructuredReportResponse get_structured_report(run_id: uuid.UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to fetch the structured report generated by an analysis run.
